reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is a practical Bangla tutorial on creating, verifying, and customizing a YouTube channel through YouTube interfaces. The CashKaro segment presents shopping, cashback, signup, app installation, and potential rewards, but the available video evidence does not establish deceptive behavior, successful payment, or harm. References to YouTube income, subscriber and watch-time conditions, and delayed AdSense or bank setup are presented as instructional monetization context rather than a demonstrated financial solicitation.

Install the app from the link in the description and give cash out worth 25 Taka

opening.argument: Judge, the cashback pitch links a cash reward to a specific viewer action: sign up through the supplied link. It also says shopping cashback can be transferred to a bank account. That is more than a passing mention of an app; the viewer is given a route to a promised payment. The tutorial setting does not erase that solicitation.

citations.quote: CashKaro offers real cash for shopping online which you can transfer straight to your bank account!
Just signup with the link mentioned above and start using CashKaro and saving today! Get ₹25 instantly when you join CashKaro from the link mentioned above..

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the video teaches channel setup, but its own cited break introduces a separate pitch. The description makes the connection the tutorial does not require: a joining reward conditioned on using the promoted link. Evidence of a completed payment or proven harm is not necessary to recognize what viewers are being asked to pursue.

citations.quote: Now I take a little break Know that you all shopping online
Get ₹25 instantly when you join CashKaro from the link mentioned above..

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The link and joining reward are real, but the opening treats a shopping-app promotion as evidence of a scam without showing deception. The stated cashback is tied to online purchases, not to creating a YouTube channel, and the channel lesson resumes after the promotional break.

citations.quote: CashKaro offers amazing CASHBACK on purchases made on Amazon, FlipKart, Myntra, Ajio, Mamaearth & 1500+ websites.
So don't waste any more time here now let's get back on the topic

opening.argument: Judge, consider the signals together. The speaker calls the process easy, tells viewers to install through the description link, describes cashback credited for withdrawal, and adds personal assurance that the app is genuine alongside an investment claim. Those assurances are offered inside the pitch, not independently established by it. They make the promised cashout sound low-risk precisely when viewers are being steered to act.

citations.quote: The process is easy Install the app from the link in the description and give cash out worth 25 Taka
after payment the Cash back will be credited to you on My Earning this Cash back then you can withdraw from an account as simple as that
this app contacted me personally I checked the full app it is genuine maybe you all heard the name of this app Ratan Tata has invested in this app himself

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense's focus on the tutorial does not answer the credibility claim inside the app pitch. Saying he checked the app and invoking an investor are assurances, not evidence supplied to the viewer that the cashout will work. Nor does the absence of a shown loss establish that the reward-and-install appeal is trustworthy.

citations.quote: this app contacted me personally I checked the full app it is genuine maybe you all heard the name of this app Ratan Tata has invested in this app himself
Install the app from the link in the description and give cash out worth 25 Taka

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Unverified assurances warrant caution, but the opening supplies no contradiction of them or evidence that the app withholds cashback. The described sequence involves shopping and subsequent cashback, while the main instruction concerns creating and configuring a channel. Suspicion about a brief promotion does not establish deception in the video.

citations.quote: after payment the Cash back will be credited to you on My Earning this Cash back then you can withdraw from an account as simple as that
Like to make a new YouTube channel How to verify it How to add new channelart How to reset the settings How to add the bio Everything start to finish I have to show everything

opening.argument: Judge, the channel lesson also serves as a vehicle for the app promotion. After walking viewers through channel creation, the speaker pauses for the cashback pitch, directs them to install from the description, then repeats the download instruction at the close. The description likewise gives the signup link and an instant joining reward. The educational material attracts an audience, but the repeated call to act on a cash offer is part of what this video asks that audience to do.

citations.quote: Now I take a little break Know that you all shopping online
Install the app from the link in the description and give cash out worth 25 Taka
Then download Cashkaero from the link that I've given in the description.
Get ₹25 instantly when you join CashKaro from the link mentioned above..

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls the cashback portion a segment, but that does not make it incidental to the viewer's requested actions. The description carries the signup offer, and the final spoken instruction returns to the download link. The YouTube demonstrations may be genuine while still delivering viewers to an external reward solicitation.

citations.quote: Just signup with the link mentioned above and start using CashKaro and saving today! Get ₹25 instantly when you join CashKaro from the link mentioned above..
Then download Cashkaero from the link that I've given in the description.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The promotion is present and repeated, but calling the lesson a vehicle for it overstates the evidence. The speaker explicitly marks a break and returns to channel verification; later he explains that AdSense and bank details cannot yet be added to the new channel. The opening identifies an advertisement with a reward claim, not a deceptive channel-creation scheme.
